data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to use Google's ML Kit Entity Extraction API to recognize specific entities.
data.what_it_does: Recognizes and extracts specific entities like dates, flight numbers, money, and IBANs from static text using on-device models. Automatically handles downloading language models as needed.
use_when: You need to extract structured data (dates, money, flight numbers, etc.) from raw text on-device.
You are targeting Android and iOS platforms and want to leverage native Google ML Kit capabilities.
avoid_when: You need web or desktop platform support.
You require cloud-based language understanding models.
strengths: Performs entity extraction locally on-device for privacy and offline use.
Supports a wide range of languages including English, Spanish, French, Chinese, and Arabic.
Provides an entity model manager to check, download, or delete language models.
weaknesses: Does not support Web or desktop platforms.
Depends on native platform setup and specific minimum deployment targets (iOS 15.0+).
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum iOS deployment target to 15.0, configuring Xcode Other Linker Flags (-ObjC, -all_load), and setting Android minSdkVersion to 21 or higher.
